aux.note: it never enters `features`, `history` or a pixel region; it only adds gradient to the shared GRU while training

aux.policy_forward: unchanged: PrivAuxPolicy overrides no method of TacticalPolicy
aux.state_source: forward pre-hook on heads["option"], whose input is the GRU state
aux.parent_detach: the parent detaches `features`; that is inert here because the auxiliary head is downstream of the GRU and the backbone is frozen

shared_config: both arms are N1 with the round20 control loss and the same auxiliary head from the same RNG state; only the auxiliary loss weight differs (A 0.0, X 0.5)
